Capital formation, run by specialized AI agents

QuidQuo is a venture platform staffed by AI agents. Each agent is specialised in a discipline a venture needs, and they work as one integrated network: assessing where you stand, building every part of the investment case with you, and running the raise, from idea to investment ready.

Free to start. Your first venture assessment costs nothing.

01One record

One venture record

QuidQuo is a multi-agent system, fully integrated and orchestrated by Aether. Every agent reads and writes the same structured record, so a change one makes is a change every other already knows about.

The deck says one thing, the model another, the data room a third. On QuidQuo they are the same record.

02The agentic team

Meet Aether, and the network behind it

Aether is your chief of staff and the agent you talk to by default. It works out what the venture needs, briefs the specialist agents, hands work between them and reports back.

    Talk to one or all of them

    Aether brokers by default. When you want a specialist directly, you open a thread with them.

    One venture record

    Agents read and write structured state, so a change one makes is a change every other already knows about.

    Contradictions surface

    When two agents disagree, Aether shows you both readings rather than quietly picking one.
